versions.changelog:
rust-restore-video 1.0.2

- Documentation updates to SKILL.md: improved clarity, prerequisites, boundaries, and prompt expansion instructions.
- No changes to code or functional workflow; update is documentation-only.

Version 1.0.1

- Updated and clarified documentation in SKILL.md.
- Expanded instructions on reviewing and confirming the use of local image files for image-to-video requests.
- Emphasized explicit user consent and script review requirements for handling local images.
- No changes to code or API; this update is documentation-only.

rust-restore-video 1.0.0 — Initial release

- Generate vertical (9:16) satisfying rust restoration short videos from text prompts or rusty-object images using WeryAI.
- Requires WERYAI_API_KEY and Node.js 18+; CLI invokes scripts/video_gen.js which relies on resources/WERYAI_VIDEO_API.md.
- Mandatory prompt expansion: user briefs are rewritten into full English video prompts before each request.
- Full workflow, security/disclosure notes, parameter tables, and strict confirmation steps documented in SKILL.md.
- API and model configuration handled via local, reviewed scripts; user consent needed before local images are read/uploaded.
